notes.title: New update! Added Simplified Chinese and Russian localization!
notes.content:
Update includes:

- Small bug fixes.

notes.title: New Update! - New languages localization and more
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113345/c016631d5b7c04bacf80b4700ecc7a1487c50186.jpg

Hey drivers! 

We are pleased to announce our new update is now live! 

This update includes: 

 Menus and subtitles in English, German, French, Spanish and Japanese.
 Difficulty adjustments.
 Easier audio cues in easy difficulty 
 Option to skip levels after several crashes.


If you have any more requests or suggestions please feel free to post them in our Steam Discussion page. 

And if you're enjoying the game, please leave a review, it really helps!
